comparison_boundary: wm_confidence vs wm_uniform changes the actual confidence weighting, including its effective model-loss magnitude, at the same nominal coefficient0.25; not a ranking-only intervention.
model_loss_formula: Bootstrap probability1 uses mean(weight * elementwise Huber delta1), with original batch/ensemble denominator. Synthetic coefficient0.25 in both WM arms; uniform weights1, confidence native exp(QDelta). There is no sum(weight) division.
interpretation: Conditional continuation diagnostic on already analyzed Halifax72571-72573 demand cases. real continuation and55k stage reference differ in update count and critic/actor recipe; confidence-vs-uniform is the matched weighting test. No physical sim-to-real or cross-city population claim.
weighting: Equal case/seed weights; three actual rule runs reused across nine pairs; all seeds retained, no population CI.
